name: helper-card-used-in
goal: Each helper card shows a smaller Used In row with up to three distinct component, service or model consumers linking within the selected revision

evidence: Feature specification defines a smaller Used In row with three distinct per-helper component, service or model links, retaining branch and commit. Existing card has only its invocation.

Existing card SSR and standardized catalog browser cases enforced one link and omitted consumer navigation. Updated them, and extracted their shared helpers fixture with a model, duplicates, excluded kinds, missing ids and fourth eligible consumer. Browser matrix covers three viewports and both current and selected commit.

Frozen test commit f9bb993a fails across desktop, tablet and mobile: helper cards expose their consumers (Used In group absent). Record bb03f264ede125a7424cc3fd27ba089b45822cd7764cfd147970f5edcf104007. Same-checkpoint screenshots copied to /tmp/harness-helper-usedin-before.

Catalog rows resolve each helper own runtime consumer ids to three distinct component/service/model links, skipping missing, removed and excluded units. ExplorerFunctionCard uses existing EntityLink and smaller text, with a dash if no eligible consumers. No new controls or visual component abstractions.

Unchanged frozen browser matrix and unit tests pass at 9890fe0b, record 376528bfaf1807f404a6257bfe33ac2a687db9ea6ae2ebded8dad0a8acb26777. Desktop/tablet/mobile verify three consumer categories, smaller text, limit/dedup and navigation at current and selected commit; card/catalog SSR tests also pass.
